<a id="music_instrument_ptrs"></a>
### [`music_instrument_ptrs`](../../../src/music_tables.asm#L37) `$0F86-$0FB7`

*data*

Addresses of the 25 instrument records. Record: waveform; for pulse 5 bytes (width lo/hi, LFO flag, shift, LFO speed); AD, SR, slide step, octave offset, filter flag. Record, filter part (flag nonzero): mode, resonance, cutoff lo/hi, sweep slot ($80 none), sweep shift, sweep direction.

- **Read by:** [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A06`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L50) (+14), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A0C`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L52) (+15), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A12`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L54) (+24), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A1B`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L57) (+25), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A2C`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L65) (+34), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A32`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L67) (+35), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A38`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L69) (+44), [`music_play_frame`](music_driver.md#music_play_frame) [`$0A3E`](../../../src/music_driver.asm#L71) (+45)
